lines.text: SUB BY : DENI AUROR@ https://aurorarental.blogspot.com/ Are you ready, kids?

* oh... * * who lives in a pineapple under the sea? * * Spongebob Squarepants! * * absorbent and yellow and porous is he. * * Spongebob Squarepants! * * if nautical nonsense be something you wish... * * Spongebob Squarepants! * * then drop on the deck and flop like a fish. * * Spongebob Squarepants! * * ready? Spongebob Squarepants! * * Spongebob Squarepants! * * Spongebob Squarepants! * * Spongebob Squarepants! *
You know what they say: Curiosity salted the snail.
Mind your wandering eye, you little mollusk.
I don't have a driver's license.
I sure take a good picture.
Darn! I should have grown a moustache.
How could i have forgotten the most important rule of driving?
Hey! I can see the krusty krab from here.
I finally got my driver's license.
Not even in your dreams, mr. Squarepants.
I'm going to get a closer look.
Wow, look at all these books.
How dare you invade The sanctity of my dreams!
In dreams, one is not tethered by earthly limitations.
For ages, dreams have been thought of As windows to another realm.
"Let me not mar that perfect dream "By an auroral stain "But so adjust my daily night That it may come again."
"There once was a man from peru "Who dreamed he was eating his shoe "He woke with a fright in the middle of the night To find that his dream had come true."
Gee, Gary, you sure are smart.
Did you think my shell was full of hot air?
I'm going back to my own dream.
Beware of your wandering eye, you little poriferan.
You know, Patrick, this is a dream.
You can do anything you want.
Watch-- I can turn into a skyscraper.
I'm going to a different dream.
Oh, this is going to be good!
Why do you stop playing, wolfgang amadeus tentacles?
Hey, i have not instructed you to stop!
Do tell me the one About the man from peru again.
I came here to hear beautiful music.
If i don't get my wish, it'll be your head!
Why have you stopped playing That wonderful music?
His music touches me ever so.
I fear that my tears might stain my petticoat.
Thank you, thank you, thank you.
What is this instrument That produces such lovely sound?
Hey, Spongebob, what brings you here?
Well, we're free-Falling From 114,000 feet And we'll land on that itty-Bitty target.
Not as long as you got a big, old parachute.
No more messing with people's dreams.
Oh, pearl, this is your dream.
You're just in time for the tea party.
I was looking for your dad's dream.
Boys don't understand the sophistication of tea parties.
I bet Mister Krabs's dream will be more robust.
I got you now, you slippery demon!
You're putting up a good fight.
I'm talking about cold, hard, flipping cash!
I got her-- Here she comes.
Never mind the small change, lad.
Wow! You look real good with a moustache, Mister Krabs.
Get it, Spongebob, get it, get it!
This'll make a great fish story, eh, Mister Krabs?
Hey, plankton's dreaming about bikini bottom.
Oh, look, it's the krusty krab Home of the krabby patty.
I think he's got the point.
Well, i guess i've got some explaining to do, huh?
Ah, that was fun and all But it's good to be back in my own dream cloud.
What do you want from me?
Hey! What are you all doing in your pajamas?
Are we having a slumber party?
No, we are not having a slumber party.
Do us all a favor, Spongebob And stay out of our dreams.
Don't we get enough of you during the day?
A quick midnight snack, and then it's back to bed.
Ah, sleep tight, my little angel.
Nothing like a sea-Nut butter and jellyfish jelly sandwich To help you get to sleep.
Oh, Gary, i don't feel like myself.
If i had the suds, i'd have bubbles coming out of me.
I can't get the suds Because then i'll have to miss work.
I like wearing my underwear like this.
Spongebob, what's holding up those patties?
You're paler than a baby sea horse.
Here's that patty you wanted, Mister Krabs, sir.
All right, Spongebob, you're too sick to work.
No, Mister Krabs, i'm okay, honest.
No, now go home and get some rest.
I just can't have you sneezing all over my food.
Oh, who am i kidding, Gary?
I've got the suds, no doubt about it.
I better take care of this before it gets out of hand.
Can you escort me to the doctor's?
Oh, sure, Spongebob I'll be there faster than a barefoot jackrabbit On a hot greasy griddle in the middle of august...
I know a guy who knows a guy Who went to the doctor once And the doctor's office is a horrible, horrible place.
It can't be as horrible as the suds.
Well, first they make you sit in the... waiting room.
Is that the horrible part, Patrick?
They make you read old magazines.
Then the doctor pulls out his stethoscope.
It's a device so sinister So icy cold when it touches your bare flesh It...
Patrick, i don't want to go the doctor.
You got to help me get better, Patrick.
Would you like to be my doctor, Patrick?
It appears as though We'll have to plug up these holes.
This ought to do the trick.
At this rate i'll be cured in no time.
In fact, i'm going to call Sandy And tell her not to come.
And they said i'd never make anything out of myself.
My fingers are too big for the buttons.
Dr. Patrick, could you call Sandy for me?
I'm calling on behalf of my patient, Spongebob.
I'm on my way over To take him to the hospital.
Uh... uh... that will no longer be required.
He is in my care as of today.
Well, i'm coming over to take a look.
I'll be over there faster than a barefoot jackrabbit on a hot...
We've got to make sure you're well Or she'll take you to the doctor.
Patrick, sometimes i just don't understand you.
Uh... uh... he's not here at the moment.
Please leave a message after the beep.
Since when do you have two houses?
Since i ran out of space to put my stuff.
Since when does your house have feet?
Hmm, the dirt therapy seems to be working just fine.
Patrick, Spongebob has to see a real doctor.
See? He's even worse than i thought.
I'm taking you to the doctor right now.
You can't take him to the doctor's.
Now look what you've done, Patrick.
Everything was fine until you showed up.
You should be arrested for impersonating a doctor.
Well, mr. Squarepants, it seems you have the suds.
Are you ready for your treatment?
You're not going to make me Read old magazines, are you?
No, silly, you get the sponge treatment.
I feel as good as new.
Hey, doc, i got the suds, too.
We have a special treatment for you.
